statements.text: The group is one Tab stop: the checked segment, or the first enabled one. Arrow keys (mirrored right to left), Home and End move focus and select together, like native radios, and fire change.
Each segment is a radio named by its slotted text. An aria-label on a violet-segment is not forwarded, so an icon-only segment still needs readable text in its slot.

events.description: Emitted when the selected value changes.
events.name: change

summary: Single-choice group of violet-segment buttons for switching between a few short, mutually exclusive options such as views or modes.

usage.text: Children are violet-segment elements, each with a unique non-empty value and its visible text in the default slot. The control checks the segment whose value equals its value; do not set checked on segments.
value defaults to empty, which leaves every segment unchecked. Set value to one segment's value so a choice shows on first render.
change fires on click and arrow-key selection only, as a plain event with no detail; read the value property. No input event fires, and setting value in script fires nothing.
Disabling the control disables every segment. A disabled segment is skipped by the arrow keys and never becomes the Tab stop.
